description: Log in with email + password. Returns a bearer `token` (reusable, long-lived; remembered for the rest of this MCP session). NOTE: accounts created via register_account have NO password by default — keep using the token from register instead. To be able to log in later, call `set_password` once while still authenticated with your register token. Requires: a password set earlier with set_password. Typical error: 401 invalid credentials (register_account accounts have no password until set_password).
name: login
title: Log in
